findings.title: Past watering form accepts a negative amount in litres
findings.expected: An amount of -5 litres is refused with a message such as 'Enter an amount in litres greater than zero.'
findings.actual: The watering is saved and the page says 'Recorded -5 L on 12 Nov 2026.'. The /waterings list then shows '-5 L'. The client only rejects exactly 0, and the input has no min.
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Recorded -5 L on 12 Nov 2026."],"negative":[{"id":3,"bed_id":1,"bed_name":"North bed","watered_on":"2026-11-12","watered_at":null,"litres":-5}],"n0":2,"n1":3} | {"alerts":["Recorded -5 L on 12 Nov 2026."],"negative":[{"id":3,"bed_id":1,"bed_name":"North bed","watered_on":"2026-11-12","watered_at":null,"litres":-5}],"n0":2,"n1":3}

findings.title: POST /api/waterings stores negative litres
findings.expected: 422 for litres -20 (WateringIn.litres has le=10000 but no lower bound)
findings.actual: 201 Created with litres -20. The record shows as '-20 L' in the watering log.

findings.title: Malformed waterings response crashes the list and leaves it stuck on 'Loading waterings…' with stale rows
findings.expected: A visible error and no uncaught exception
findings.actual: Uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function'. The page keeps showing 'Loading waterings…' forever, and the North bed filter still lists the old Shade corner rows.
